description: Beginner-friendly subset of OLL that splits last-layer orientation into two algorithms: first orient edges (OELL: 3 cases), then orient corners with edges already oriented (OCLL: 7 cases identical to OLL 21-27). Total 10 algorithms vs 57 for full OLL.

cases.name: Dot
cases.recognition: U face shows the cross color on the center only; all 4 edges have the cross color on a side face.

algorithms.moves: F (R U R' U') F' f (R U R' U') f'
algorithms.notes: Standard two-look dot solver: F-sexy-F' followed by f-sexy-f' (wide-F variant) skips the L case in one go.

algorithms.moves: f (R U R' U') f' F (R U R' U') F'
algorithms.notes: Same idea with the wide-F portion first.

cases.name: L Shape
cases.recognition: Two adjacent edges have the cross color on the U face, forming an L with the center (also known as a 'bar').

algorithms.moves: f (R U R' U') f'
algorithms.notes: Hold the L in the back-left, then wide-F sexy wide-F'.

algorithms.moves: F U R U' R' F'
algorithms.notes: Alternative grip that avoids the wide move.

cases.name: Line
cases.recognition: Two opposite edges have the cross color on the U face, forming a horizontal line through the center.

algorithms.moves: F (R U R' U') F'
algorithms.notes: Hold the line horizontally (left-to-right), then F sexy F'.

cases.name: Sune
cases.recognition: One corner shows the cross color on top (positioned front-left). Looks like a fish.

algorithms.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.notes: The Sune. RUR'-URU2R'. One of the most iconic speedcubing algs.

algorithms.moves: L' U' L U' L' U2 L

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.recognition: One corner shows the cross color on top (positioned front-right). The mirror of Sune.

algorithms.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'
L' U2 L U L' U L

cases.name: H
cases.recognition: Two opposite corners need to twist clockwise, two need to twist counter-clockwise. All 4 corners look 'wrong'.

algorithms.moves: R U R' U R U' R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.notes: Often called 'double Sune' because it resembles Sune-then-Sune.

algorithms.moves: F (R U R' U')3 F'

cases.name: Pi
cases.recognition: Two adjacent corners need to twist one way, two adjacent corners need to twist the other way. Resembles the Greek letter Pi.

algorithms.moves: R U2 R2 U' R2 U' R2 U2 R
f (R U R' U') f' F (R U R' U') F'
algorithms.notes: Two-step approach: solves Pi as L-then-Line.

cases.name: U
cases.recognition: Two adjacent corners are correct ('headlights') and the other two need to swap orientations.

algorithms.moves: R2 D R' U2 R D' R' U2 R'
algorithms.notes: Hold the headlights on the back; the other two corners are at the front.

algorithms.moves: F (R U R' U')3 F'
algorithms.notes: Also works since 3x sexy + F-conjugate solves multiple OCLL cases.

cases.name: T
cases.recognition: Two diagonally opposite corners are correct; the other two need to swap orientations.

algorithms.moves: r U R' U' r' F R F'
R U R' U' R' F R F'
algorithms.notes: Sledgehammer-style variant without the wide move.

cases.name: L
cases.recognition: Two diagonally opposite corners are correct; the other two need to swap orientations the opposite direction from the T case.

algorithms.moves: F' r U R' U' r' F R
R' F' L F R F' L' F
algorithms.notes: Symmetric variant some prefer; involves an L move.

algorithms.moves: x R' U R D' R' U' R D x'
